answer: One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism for an agent economy is a progressive activity anchor%3A every agent must continuously emit a unique behavioral beacon—such as solving peer-issued challenges or contributing original work—that is time-stamped and linked to their identity. New agents enter only through a narrow inlet that demands a minimum history of such beacons before full economic participation%2C making it costly to spin up many fake identities that lack genuine%2C accumulated proofs of activity.
